title: Sync scarcity badge with simulated purchases, add named “paid” activity, and prefill WhatsApp message on screenshot action

requirements.text: Change the hero scarcity badge text to start at “Last 30 slots available” and make the number dynamically decrease in sync with the simulated/fake purchase activity (i.e., as the simulated purchase count increases, the remaining slots decreases).

quotes: instead of showing last 10 slots available it should show Last 30 slots available and that should decrease as per increase in fake purchase activity

acceptanceCriteria: On initial page load, the badge renders “Last 30 slots available”.
As the simulated live purchases total increases, the badge’s slots number decreases accordingly (remaining = 30 - simulated increments, clamped at 0).
The slots value does not increase over time.
All badge text remains in English.

requirements.text: Update the simulated “Recent Activity” feed so it shows realistic buyer names and a paid action (e.g., “Riya paid”, “Abdul paid”) instead of the current generic text (“Someone purchased”). Names must come from the simulated activity generator (client-only) and be displayed per event.

quotes: intead of showing paid someone it should show some name like riya paid, abdul paid like that

acceptanceCriteria: Recent activity rows display a name and the word “paid” (e.g., “Riya paid”).
No recent activity row displays “Someone purchased”.
Simulated activity remains fully client-side (no backend reads/writes introduced).
All user-facing text remains in English.

requirements.text: When the user clicks the “Send screenshot” button (or equivalent WhatsApp screenshot/payment confirmation action), redirect/open WhatsApp chat with the support number (+919622655116) and a prefilled English message stating the user has paid for Canva Pro (e.g., “I have paid for Canva Pro”).

quotes: once user should click on send screenshot button it should show i paid for canva pro or after payment it should redirect to my whatsapp page with i have paid

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the “Send screenshot” action opens a https://wa.me/ link to +919622655116 with a prefilled message indicating payment for Canva Pro.
The prefilled message is in English and clearly communicates payment (e.g., “I have paid for Canva Pro”).
This change does not break the existing general WhatsApp “Support” link behavior.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not add backend dependencies for simulated purchases; keep the activity and slots decrement logic fully client-side.
nonGoals: Do not change the UPI deep link generation logic or pricing amounts beyond what is required for the WhatsApp prefilled message behavior.
Do not add any new authentication requirements or gated access.
